name: Custom Shape Wooden Puzzles Growth Chart
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, offering a sturdy, durable, and charming decorative finish for children’s room décor.
    - Made from 3mm thick wood, providing a lightweight yet stable structure for wall display and long-term use.
    - Designed as a multi-piece puzzle-style growth chart, allowing the sections to connect together for easy assembly.
    - Includes a wooden height marker for recording important growth milestones in a fun and meaningful way.
    - Comes with adhesive dots for wall attachment and flexible installation.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - The chart is designed with the following maximum dimensions:
            +) Maximum height: 64 in ~ 162.56 cm
            +) Maximum width:
                         -> Style 1: 11 in ~ 27.94 cm
                         -> Style 2: 22 in ~ 55.88 cm
    - Main panel sections: Each main panel piece:
            +) Maximum width: 11 in ~ 27.94 cm
            +) Maximum height: 16 in ~ 40.64 cm
    - Height marker size:
            +) Minimum marker size: 0.79 x 0.79 in ~ 2 x 2 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - All wooden panels support single-sided printing.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a growth chart and a personalized decorative wall piece.
    - Designed to help track a child’s height over time while also serving as a meaningful room decoration.
    - Suitable for bedrooms, nurseries, playrooms, classrooms, and family spaces.
    - The included height marker can be used to record name and date details for memorable milestone moments.
    - Puzzle-style sections allow convenient assembly and help create a fun, interactive design.
    - Perfect for documenting growth memories in a charming and personalized way.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for kids, parents, family members, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for baby showers, birthdays, back-to-school gifts, nursery décor, and milestone celebrations.
    - Ideal for children’s bedrooms, playrooms, classrooms, and keepsake wall displays.
    - A thoughtful gift for parents who want to preserve growth memories in a decorative and fun format.
    - Great for first birthdays, room makeovers, family keepsakes, and personalized nursery gifts.
    - Adds a warm, playful, and memorable touch to any child’s space🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Wooden Puzzles Growth Chart

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
